description.value: The Whistler Public Library is a LEED Gold certified 12,000-square-foot public facility that has anchored the Whistler community since 1986 and is celebrating its 40th anniversary in 2026. Located centrally on Main Street in Whistler Village, it offers an impressive range of programs and creative spaces including a Wonder Lab, Creation Station, Digitization Station, Green Screen, and Sound Booth. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming, fully accessible public space steps from the village core.
